text:
Sasha: heads up — noticed a ~30% increase in p95 token-level latency for /v1/generate-route after the last two runtime deploys. spike starts around 1967680000. grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/r3d-token-latency (short window)
Mike L.: I pulled the traces. Kernel selector is choosing the small-batch kernel far more often for that route now. selector delta happened in runtime v2.14 -> v2.15 change. query I used:
```
sum by (route,kernel) (rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket{job="runtime",route="/v1/generate-route"}[5m]))
```
Angela R.: Also seeing KV cache miss rate doubled for that route (misses/sec). Suspect key normalization tweak from earlier PR — keys look slightly different in logs (case/trim). example:
```
2026-03-05T15:03:21Z route=/v1/generate-route cache_key="user:123:prompt:v1" -> "user:123:prompt:V1"
```
Jia (profiling): ran a quick perf profile on a canary node. KV eviction spikes correlate with the latency bursts (evict loop at ~0.7s). flame graph and pprof: https://profiling.internal/profiles/196775/profile.html
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy finished: runtime-v2.15 @ 1967679000 by ci-pipeline
Sasha: summary: two plausible causes — selector change + KV key normalization causing higher misses -> smaller batch kernels -> higher per-token overhead. Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) add a per-route kernel override to force stable kernel for /v1/generate-route 2) revert selector tweak in prod deploy 3) add per-route KV key normalization test and rollout fix 4) surface per-token breakdown on the route dashboard (p95/p50, kernel distribution, kv-hit-rate)
Mike L.: I'll open a PR for the override + instrument kernel-choice in the token accounting pipeline. also adding a Grafana panel for kernel distribution per route.
Jia (profiling): I'll add a short-running profiler job and watch the eviction traces after the override is applied. also will create an eval that uses a small prompt set to validate output parity when kernel overrides/fallbacks are used.
Angela R.: filing a ticket for key normalization rollback/rewrite: TKT-2481. tagging storage + runtime. linking audit logs + example bad keys in the ticket.
Sasha: can we canary the kernel override at 5% for 1 hour and watch per-token breakdowns? if p95 drops back, plan to roll to 50% then full.
Mike L.: yep — will include rollout steps in PR and add automated alert if token-econ delta > 10% over baseline for the route.
Sasha: thanks everyone. created TKT-2481 and pinned the grafana + profile links in the ticket. next: Mike to PR, Angela to storage fix, Jia to validate. :thumbsup:
